title: Ninja DualZone XL £159.99, Shark StainForce £99 and LEGO Bluey House £42.99
description: Tuesday's UK deals: the Ninja DualZone XL below its recent low, Shark's StainForce spot cleaner at £99 and 25% off designer perfume gift sets.
intro:
**Tuesday's best buy is the Ninja DualZone XL air fryer at £159.99 at John Lewis, £80 off and cheaper than it has been at any point in the last three months.** Its bigger sibling, the Double Stack XL, is also at its three-month low, and Shark's cordless StainForce spot cleaner is down to £99. For gifts, John Lewis has 25% off designer perfume sets from Rabanne and Dolce & Gabbana, and Tom Ford's Black Orchid set is 20% off.

For this week's toy theme, Smyths has the LEGO Bluey Family House £17 under the price at LEGO and John Lewis. Every price below was read on the retailer's own product page today, 10 November. Buy now or wait? The two Ninjas and the Shark are already at or below their recent lows, so there's little reason to hold out. The perfume sets could go a touch lower in Black Friday week, but popular gift sets often sell out first.

deals.name: Ninja DualZone XL DZ901UK 9.5L Air Fryer, Grey
deals.note: Two large drawers that cook different foods at once and finish together, big enough for a family. Price trackers show nothing lower in the last three months, and Ninja itself still charges £239.99. More in our [air fryer Black Friday guide](/guides/air-fryer-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Ninja Double Stack XL SL400UK 9.5L Air Fryer, Grey
deals.note: Ninja's stacked air fryer, which fits two drawers in the footprint of one, so it suits smaller kitchens. Argos says it was £270, but Ninja sells it for £199.99, so the real saving is £20. Still, £179.99 matches its three-month low, and John Lewis and Amazon charge the same. See our [Ninja Black Friday guide](/guides/ninja-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Shark StainForce HX100UKT Cordless Spot Cleaner, White
deals.note: A handheld cleaner for spills on carpets, sofas and car seats, handy with pets or small children. £99 is the lowest price on record, and Amazon matches it; Argos and Very are £10 more.

deals.name: Rabanne Lady Million Eau de Parfum 50ml Gift Set
deals.note: The 50ml perfume with a 100ml body lotion and a 10ml travel spray. It was 15% off last week and is now 25% off. Our [perfume gift set guide](/guides/perfume-gift-sets-black-friday-2026/) has more to compare.

deals.name: Dolce & Gabbana The One Eau de Parfum 75ml Gift Set
deals.note: A large 75ml bottle with body lotion and a travel spray, now 25% off after a smaller cut last week. A safe pick if she already wears The One.

deals.name: Tom Ford Black Orchid Eau de Parfum 50ml Gift Set
deals.note: A 50ml bottle plus a 10ml travel spray. Tom Ford is rarely discounted by more than 20%, and John Lewis says it has matched another retailer's price. See our [Christmas gifts for her under £50](/guides/christmas-gifts-for-her-under-50/) for cheaper ideas.

deals.name: LEGO Bluey Bluey's Family House (11203)
deals.note: The Heeler family home in LEGO, a strong present for young Bluey fans. £59.99 is a real price, as LEGO and John Lewis both charge it today. Smyths also takes £5 off every £50 spent on LEGO. More in our [LEGO Black Friday guide](/guides/lego-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Bluey 3-in-1 Transforming Plane Playset
deals.note: A plane that opens out into a playset, for pre-schoolers. Smyths claims it was £59.99, which looks high, but £29.99 is still the cheapest we found: The Entertainer is £33.75 for collection only, and John Lewis has sold out. For more ideas, see [Christmas gifts for kids under £20](/guides/christmas-gifts-for-kids-under-20/).

body:
## Worth waiting for?

The two Ninja air fryers and the Shark spot cleaner are already at their lowest recent prices, so we'd buy now. Big-brand perfume gift sets usually bottom out at around 25–30% off, which is where the Rabanne and Dolce & Gabbana sets are today. Tom Ford rarely goes lower than this. Our [Black Friday guides](/black-friday/) list the prices worth holding out for, brand by brand.

## This week: Christmas toys

Bluey is one of the strongest toy licences this Christmas, and Smyths has cut a lot of it. Popular toys tend to sell out before they get cheaper, so if a child has asked for something specific, it's worth buying now. Our [Christmas toy deals 2026 spotlight](/spotlight/christmas-toy-deals-2026/) covers what to buy now and what to wait for, and our [Hamleys Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/hamleys-black-friday-2026/) explains Hamleys's offers.
